name: client-bash
why: one client tool: the ordinary Task subagent shape

name: client-two-tools
why: several client tools, one with an empty but non-null schema

name: server-tool-only
why: the WebSearch helper: a SERVER tool carries no input_schema, so it is not an agent

name: null-input-schema
why: an explicit JSON null schema is the same as none

name: empty-tools
why: an array with no entries (the haiku helper's shape)

name: tools-absent
why: no tools key at all (the key is omitted from the fixture object)

name: tools-not-an-array
why: the whole tools value has the wrong type, so the declaration is unreadable

name: mixed-scalar-element
why: a scalar among the entries makes the array unreadable as a tool list

name: null-element-beside-client-tool
why: a null entry is an empty declaration, not a malformed one, so the client tool still counts

name: string-input-schema
why: any non-null value counts, including one that is not an object
